title: Career Roadmap · Solar Technician
summary: A Solar Technician installs, tests, maintains and troubleshoots solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, including panels, inverters, wiring and related electrical equipment.

facts.Course: Diploma - Renewable Energy / EV Technology / Solar

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10/12 → Solar PV / Electrical diploma or vocational training → supervised practical experience → Solar Technician → Senior Technician / Site Supervisor.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics is useful; vocational routes may accept other qualifications.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Physics, Mathematics, basic electrical science and computer applications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Solar panels, electricity generation, batteries, inverters and energy efficiency.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Safe tool handling, electrical safety, measurement, teamwork and troubleshooting.

blocks.label: Training route
blocks.text: Explore recognized ITI, polytechnic and solar-PV training options; check current eligibility and certification requirements.

items.text: ITI Electrician / related electrical trade → Electrical installation and maintenance foundations.
Diploma in Electrical Engineering → Solar installation, wiring and system maintenance.
Diploma / certificate in Solar PV Technology → Solar-specific installation and troubleshooting.
Diploma in Renewable Energy Engineering, where offered → Solar and other clean-energy technologies.
B.Tech. Electrical / Renewable Energy Engineering → Advanced design, project engineering and technical leadership.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Eligibility, course availability and certification routes vary. Verify current official notifications before enrolling.
Government / Public

items.text: NISE — National Institute of Solar Energy, Haryana; explore solar training and capacity-building programmes.
Government ITIs — check current Electrician and relevant electrical trade offerings.
Government polytechnics in Andhra Pradesh — verify Diploma in Electrical Engineering availability.
Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) — check current renewable-energy skill programmes.
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) / approved training partners — investigate solar-PV skill training.

blocks.text: Private / Industry Training

items.text: Tata Power Skill Development Institute — investigate solar and electrical skill programmes.
Skill training centres accredited for relevant solar-PV qualifications.
Electrical engineering polytechnics with renewable-energy lab facilities.
Renewable-energy companies offering structured technician training.
Approved ITI / vocational institutes offering electrical installation training.

blocks.text: These are training routes to investigate, not a ranking. Verify the current course, recognition, practical workshop access, assessment and fees with the provider.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Electrical basics, workplace safety, tools and solar PV fundamentals.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Panel installation, wiring, inverter connections and system testing under supervision.

blocks.label: Year 3 / work experience
blocks.text: Maintenance, fault diagnosis, commissioning and site documentation.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Small solar-panel demonstration; calculate energy output from sample data; create a preventive-maintenance checklist; inspect a simulated solar installation for safety issues.

blocks.label: Government / training
blocks.text: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE), approved training partners and eligible renewable-energy skill programmes.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Solar installation firms, rooftop solar vendors, EPC contractors and renewable-energy maintenance companies.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Solar EPC companies, inverter manufacturers, solar module manufacturers and local installation contractors.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Panel installation, electrical wiring, inverter testing and preventive maintenance.

NISE’s Suryamitra programme trains eligible candidates for solar installation, commissioning, operation and maintenance. Its official directory lists training centres in Nellore, Andhra Pradesh; confirm current batches and eligibility before applying.
Suryamitra Skill Development Programme

blocks.label: Advanced route
blocks.text: Diploma / degree in Electrical Engineering → Solar Design / Project Engineer.

blocks.label: Alternative
blocks.text: Solar PV training → battery storage, EV charging or renewable-energy service roles with additional training.

blocks.text: Certification requirements vary by employer, project and applicable electrical-safety rules. Never work on live electrical systems or at height without appropriate training and supervision.

blocks.label: Typical route

items.text: Direct employment depends on practical experience, local regulations, vacancies and work authorization. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.
